north_star: A beautiful, fast fixed-lane age war that is as instantly readable as a great mobile battler and as strategically expressive as a deep counter game.
pillars: Fixed side-view battlefield with no camera-management burden
Front-line infantry, independently firing ranged ranks, and protected rear siege
Distinct historical silhouettes and architecture for every age
Literal troop research paths that visibly improve the army
Fast AI pressure, clear counters, and restrained tower abilities

siege_contract.catapult: unlocks in the third age and attacks towers only
siege_contract.springald: unlocks in the third age, attacks siege first, attacks a tower only when no enemy siege exists, and never attacks normal troops

reference_art_rule: Supplied concept images guide composition, density, color, and hierarchy; gameplay uses separated engine-native systems and clean production assets rather than pasting a screenshot over the game.
production_status: Unreal fixed-lane source now owns formations, independent ranged attacks, research, age progression, siege rules, AI, towers, and HUD; Unreal Editor compile, packaged-player smoke testing, authored assets, animation, audio, and final rendered-frame polish remain required
